title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Humphreys Concerts By The Bay, San Diego | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Humphreys Concerts By The Bay in San Diego, California, USA, on 29 June 2006.

It was the 11th show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Starr had previously performed at Humphreys Concerts By The Bay on 16 August 1995, 4 May 1997, 25 and 26 June 2000, and 7 September 2003. He returned there on 27 July 2008, 6 August 2010, 19 July 2012, 11 July 2014, 1 July 2016, 27 September 2018, 28 and 31 May 2023, 7 September 2024, and 29 May 2026.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
